name: Build desktop app

# Nuitka cannot cross-compile, so each OS builds its own sidecar and installer.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Build the backend sidecar
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
          pip install ./webuntis
          pip install nuitka
          bash backend/build_sidecar.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: src-tauri

      - name: Install JS dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm --prefix frontend ci

      - name: Build the app bundle
        run: npm run build -- --target ${{ matrix.target }}
        env:
          # macOS: omit to produce an unsigned build that Gatekeeper will warn on.
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: installers-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: |
            src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg
            src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/bundle/msi/*.msi
            src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/bundle/nsis/*.exe
          if-no-files-found: warn
